question: Why does only 18.8% of signups activate within 7 days?
hypothesis: Activation varies meaningfully by acquisition channel, demographic segment, or signup cohort.
evidence_summary: Widest activation-rate spread is by `membership_type` (12.3% range); Cramér's V values across all tested segment columns are near-zero (see activation_segment_comparison.csv), echoing PR8's finding that no single categorical explains churn either.
verdict: Not explained by acquisition channel or demographics
recommended_action: Do not target activation fixes by channel/demographic segment; investigate onboarding UX/timing instead.
